description: This Java source file defines the WiFiServiceDiscoveryActivity class, which manages Wi-Fi P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) service discovery, connection, and chat functionality within an Android application. It handles service registration, discovery, connection setup, and communication between devices, including UI updates and socket management.

classes.name: WiFiServiceDiscoveryActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing Wi-Fi P2P service discovery, connection, and chat communication in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, checks device capabilities, and starts service registration and discovery.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results, proceeds with discovery if granted.

methods.name: initP2p
methods.description: Checks device support for Wi-Fi Direct and initializes WifiP2pManager and channel.

methods.name: startRegistrationAndDiscovery
methods.description: Registers local Wi-Fi P2P service and initiates service discovery.

methods.name: discoverService
methods.description: Sets DNS-SD response listeners, creates service request, and starts service discovery.

methods.name: connectP2p
methods.description: Connects to a selected Wi-Fi P2P service.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for chat and manages chat fragment setup.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver for Wi-Fi P2P events.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Handles connection info, starts socket handlers, and sets up chat fragment.

methods.name: appendStatus
methods.description: Updates status TextView with new status messages.
